in_marathi.name: Dhanaki
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanaki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dhanaki is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted carrying a bag full of gold coins, symbolizing her role as the giver of abundance. Dhanaki is also known as Lakshmi, the goddess of fortune, and is worshipped during Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights.
